rationale: Controlled Failure Simulation Rationale: In a controlled 10-step multi-stage sandbox analysis workflow, when step 7 (dynamic detonation probe) is deliberately made to fail, MailGuard enforces a fresh start recovery policy. Reusing or resuming a potentially contaminated guest microVM risks state leakage and false negative results across inspection runs. The failed sandbox is immediately deleted, orphan processes are destroyed, and a completely fresh Celesto sandbox is initialized from the verified coding-agent baseline template.
